jobs.title: Ascend Program 2027
jobs.description_text:
The Voloridge Ascend Program brings together a select group of early undergraduate and early-stage Ph.D. students to work closely with our researchers, engineers, and traders, gaining exposure to how we approach research, modeling, and system design in a trading environment. Through hands-on sessions and a collaborative simulation, you'll explore how ideas from mathematics, physics, computer science, and related quantitative disciplines are applied to complex, evolving systems. 

Admission is highly competitive, with only 20 participants selected for each cohort. Throughout the program, participants will hear directly from and receive hands-on mentorship from some of Voloridge's most senior researchers and engineers. You'll participate in technical sessions, collaborative problem-solving activities, and a team-based competition designed to challenge your analytical thinking and technical creativity while providing a firsthand look at how our teams approach difficult research problems.

There’s no expectation of prior finance knowledge. We’re looking for students who enjoy thinking deeply, questioning assumptions, and building from first principles. Participants will leave with a clearer understanding of what technical research looks like in practice, and how they might fit into it.

Program Dates:

  • January 11-14, 2027

Program Logistics:

  • Travel to and from the program will be arranged and fully covered by Volorid

jobs.description_text:
Business Development Representative

Job Description

Workshop is looking for a driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to help us grow revenue. Successful BDRs are competitive, motivated by results, and are passionate about sales and the product we’re selling. This is an exciting opportunity for someone with 0-2 years of sales experience to be part of an exciting software-as-a-service (SaaS) business. We are on pace to substantially grow this year, but need motivated and determined sales professionals to reach our goals. 

**This is a hybrid role that would be reporting to our Omaha, Nebraska office.**

Compensation: $50,000 base salary + uncapped commission 

As a business development representative, you will:

  • Prospect, educate and qualify leads
  • Reach or exceed performance metrics on calls, meetings, and sales
  • Identify the needs and challenges of the prospective customer
  • Achieve both individual and team goals
  • Schedule discovery meetings for sales representatives and prospects
  • Collaborate with team members to maximize opportunities and drive sales.
  • Work closely with the leadership team to develop targeted lists and outreach strategies 
  • Execute inbound and outbound prospecting campaigns
  • Use AI tools to personalize outreach at scale and research prospects more efficien

jobs.title: Senior Director Marketing/VP Marketing
jobs.description_text:
This is a senior role within the World Surf League (WSL) (VP/Senior Director title, as commensurate with experience and qualifications), responsible for building and executing the marketing strategy that grows WSL's audience, deepens fan engagement and positions the WSL as the home of surfing in the USA and beyond.

Successful candidate will own fan growth, digital marketing, paid media, CRM, brand tracking, and campaign execution with the range to stretch into creative and PR when the business requires it. Successful candidate will lead a team of direct reports and serve as a key partner to regional marketing leads, social media, commercial, content and events functions.

The role reports directly into the Global CMO and President of North America. Based on business and team priorities, the successful candidate should be based in Los Angeles, California, in a hybrid working environment (in office Tuesday-Thursday).

Responsibilities include:

 

Fan Acquisition & Audience Growth

  • Lead the Global and North America fan acquisition strategy with center-out model, fan segmentation and audience growth.
  • Drive viewership growth across YouTube, owned and operated platforms and broadcast, owning watch hour and unique viewer targets against OKRs.
  • Build and execute athlete-led marketing campaigns that grow the profiles of US and Hawaiian surfers ahead of LA28.

jobs.title: Sponsorships Account Manager
jobs.description_text:
We are looking for a highly motivated Sponsorships Account Manager to join our team in São Paulo. This role is ideal for a commercially driven professional with a strong hunter mentality and a passion for sports, entertainment, and cultural properties. The successful candidate will be responsible for identifying, developing, and closing new sponsorship partnerships, helping expand the league’s commercial footprint and brand ecosystem.

This is a strategic sales role focused on business development, requiring the ability to build consultative partnerships with leading brands and agencies. This is a full time role with the expectations of 5 days in the São Paulo office in Brazil. 

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and prospect new sponsorship opportunities across sports, entertainment, and brand marketing sectors
  • Develop and maintain relationships with brand decision-makers, marketing leaders, and agencies
  • Lead the full sales cycle: prospecting, pitching, negotiating, and closing sponsorship agreements
  • Design and position consultative partnership proposals aligned with brands’ marketing and business objectives
  • Collaborate internally with marketing, events, and partnerships teams to craft compelling sponsorship packages
  • Maintain an active pipeline of qualified prospects and consistently deliver new partnership revenue
  • Represent the league in meetings, events, and industry forums

jobs.title: Exploratory
jobs.location_raw: London, NYC, Abu Dhabi, Salt Lake City
jobs.description_text:
We are a global multi-strategy investment team that strives to uncover opportunities to generate consistently strong returns in a complex world.

We are quantitative researchers, developers, and traders combining intelligence and curiosity with powerful data and technology.

If you are interested in working with us but do not see a role that fits your background, we encourage you to submit an exploratory application.

jobs.title: Infrastructure Generalist
jobs.description_text:
We seek talented Infrastructure Generalists to build, evolve and maintain the core infrastructure that underpins and protects Xantium’s technology environment.  Those in this role are versatile problem solvers capable of working with leaders in Xantium’s Security, Engineering, and Operations teams.

Infrastructure Generalists operate in a greenfield, high-performance environment where their decisions can have both immediate and long-term impacts.

Key Responsibilities May Include

  • Building and maintaining infrastructure across compute, storage, networking, and cloud environments.
  • Owning system configuration, deployment, and troubleshooting across endpoints, servers, and services.
  • Defining and running experiments to improve performance, reliability, and system design.
  • Understanding latest state-of-the-art solutions and identifying fresh ideas to propose to senior leadership
  • Driving architectural decisions that support growth and operational resilience.

Requirements

  • Track record of academic and professional achievement.
  • 2+ years of experience in infrastructure or systems engineering within complex environments.
  • Deep understanding of how computers, operating systems, and networks work.
  • Strong ability to reason from first principles and debug unfamiliar systems.
  • Proven ability to experiment thoughtfully and apply lear

jobs.title: Quantitative Developer
jobs.location_raw: London, New York City, Salt Lake City
jobs.description_text:
At Xantium, our Quantitative Developers build software and frameworks that power our quantitative trading. Quantitative Developer responsibilities vary depending on the team and scope. These individuals may have Research Engineer, Software Developer, or other titles elsewhere. The common thread for our Quantitative Developers is strong programming combined with quantitative acumen

Projects for a Quantitative Developer may include:

  • Providing fast market data to a trading system
  • Building an integrated research and execution framework for fast predictors
  • Creating simulation and research frameworks in a cloud environment
  • Providing a robust research framework for a new asset class

Our tech stack is a blend of Python and C++ that runs both on-prem and in the cloud.


Compensation:  Quantitative Developers in New York can expect to earn $175,000 to $225,000+ base.  Total compensation for all Quantitative Developers also includes a large annual bonus which is guaranteed in year one and based on employee and firm performance thereafter.

jobs.title: Quantitative Developer Intern
jobs.location_raw: London, England, New York, New York
jobs.description_text:
Xantium is seeking Quantitative Developer Interns for our New York and London offices for Summer 2027.  Candidates must be in their penultimate year, studying Computer Science.  Quantitative Developer Interns will work closely with our team of Quantitative Developers and Researchers on projects powering our quantitative trading.

Examples of recent projects by our full-time Quantitative Developers:

  • Providing fast market data to a trading system
  • Building an integrated research and execution framework for fast predictors
  • Creating simulation and research frameworks in a cloud environment
  • Providing a robust research framework for a new asset class

Our tech stack is a blend of Python and C++ that runs both on-prem and in the cloud. 

If working in a dynamic, nimble environment within a flat, meritocratic organization excites you, please get in touch.  What could we achieve together?  Let’s find out.

Compensation: Quantitative Developer Interns in New York can expect to earn $16,000 to $19,000+ per month, plus relocation.

jobs.title: Quantitative Researcher
jobs.location_raw: London, New York City, Salt Lake City
jobs.description_text:
Quantitative Researchers at Xantium are responsible for researching and developing mathematical models used to identify investment and trading opportunities in the global financial markets.


The process is collaborative, involving direct access to and guidance from senior quantitative portfolio managers and engineers with years of experience across all major markets. Our Quantitative Researchers learn a range of skills including various research
techniques as well as how to work with different types of data, markets and asset classes. 

Examples of responsibilities include:

  • Analyzing and evaluating financial and alternative datasets
  • Researching existing and developing new techniques in machine learning
  • Researching, developing and implementing quantitative trading signals/models
  • Developing and maintaining modeling infrastructure
  • Supporting production trading operations

Quantitative Researcher applicants should have a PhD (or equivalent) that involved intense mathematics or statistics. We may consider candidates without PhDs, provided they can demonstrate strong competitive math backgrounds and strong academic records

Compensation: Quantitative Researchers in New York can expect to earn $175,000 to $225,000+ base. Total compensation for all Quantitative Researchers also includes a large annual bonus which is guaranteed in year one and based on employee and firm

jobs.title: Quantitative Researcher Intern
jobs.location_raw: London, England, New York, New York
jobs.description_text:
Xantium is seeking Quantitative Researcher Interns for our New York and London offices for Summer 2027.  Ideal candidates will be in their penultimate year of their PhD studies in a highly quantitative field.  We may consider individuals pursuing bachelor's and master’s degrees, provided they can demonstrate strong competitive math backgrounds and strong academic records.

Examples of responsibilities of full-time Quantitative Researchers include:

  • Analyzing and evaluating financial and alternative datasets
  • Researching existing and developing new techniques in machine learning
  • Researching, developing and implementing quantitative trading signals/models
  • Developing and maintaining modeling infrastructure
  • Supporting production trading operations

If working in a dynamic, nimble environment within a flat, meritocratic organization excites you, please get in touch.  What could we achieve together?  Let’s find out.

Compensation: Quantitative Researcher Interns in New York can expect to earn $16,000 to $19,000+ per month, plus relocation.

jobs.title: Quantitative Volatility Trader
jobs.description_text:
Quantitative Volatility Traders (QVTs) collaborate with developers and researchers to implement Xantium's derivatives trading strategies. Their roles require established Python coding skills, strong mental math, and developed market intuition.

Initial responsibilities include trading system monitoring and improvement; some roles also involve individual trade execution and support. Over time and with guidance from senior team members, all QVTs grow to better understand how the range of Xantium’s volatility strategies are developed and optimized.

We are seeking multiple QVTs for a rapidly growing team. At this time, candidates with derivatives experience in the following underlying asset types are particularly attractive: equities (single name and index), commodities, and fixed income.

All applicants should have:

  • 1-3+ years of fulltime experience trading derivatives or developing options trading systems
  • Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in hard sciences (e.g., mathematics, computer science, physics, engineering, etc.)
  • Strong Python coding skills

Compensation: Quantitative Volatility Traders in New York can expect to earn $150,000 to $225,000+ base. Total compensation for all Quantitative Volatility Traders also includes a large annual bonus which is guaranteed in year one and based on employee and firm performance thereafter.

jobs.title: Xantium Academy Fellow
jobs.location_raw: London, England; New York, New York
jobs.description_text:
Xantium Academy Fellow

We seek top early-career professionals to join our inaugural Xantium Academy Fellowship commencing the summer of 2027.  This six-month accelerated program blends structured mentorship, classroom theory, and hands-on practice across fluid tracks in Trading or Analysis.  Supported by active executive sponsorship – including direct engagement with Xantium Co-Founders – Fellows will make immediate contributions through real-world projects. 

We plan to hire 10-12 highly talented individuals with a range of experiences for our first cohort; while each person will be based in New York or London, they’ll collaborate with Xantium colleagues around the world.  The overall experience shall enable Fellows to discover their natural niche, hone in on an ideal role and team, and transition into their permanent professional home at the end of the program.

Program Structure

  • Six-Month Timeline: The program begins with an “Initial Immersion” rotation featuring 10-12 weeks of immediate, hands-on deployment into real work alongside seasoned professionals.  Fellows then transition into a 3-week cohort-wide classroom training led by experienced speakers and Xantium leadership hosted at one of Xantium’s main offices.  The experience concludes with a 10-12 week “Capstone” rotation of more advanced deployment, allowing Fellows to build off their learnings to

jobs.title: Join Our Talent Community!
jobs.description_text:
Haven’t found a job that fits your skills and interests? Join our Talent Community, which lets our recruiters know you’re open to learning about future opportunities at Xebia. This is a great way to stay connected and be considered as new roles become available.

With your consent, we would like to retain your information in the Xebia Talent Community. This allows us to keep you informed about relevant job openings, recruitment initiatives, and events that align with your background and interests.

In addition to the information you provide, Xebia may review appropriate publicly available professional information, such as LinkedIn profiles, to help identify potential role matches.

jobs.title: Analyst, Quality Assurance
jobs.description_text:
Our Mission

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.  

We’re here to give power to the patient. 

For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from seeking to getting. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

 

Your Impact on Our Mission

As a QA Analyst, you will play a key role in strengthening Zocdoc’s quality ecosystem by ensuring that every issue entering our engineering pipeline is accurate, validated, reproducible, and data-backed.

As part of a lean Business Team, you’ll work directly with a range of functions and their leads to design, optimize and execute tools and processes for business operations and business development. You will also be responsible for both internal and external communication to partners and vendors regarding our business compliance and trading operations. 

You’ll conduct research to help evaluate new business opportunities, and build dashboards, predictive models, and other tools to inform data-driven business decisions. 

Qualifications
We’re looking for highly analytical people who want to help build the research-driven trading firm of the future. jobs.title: Quantitative Researcher (Full-Time - Master’s/Bachelor’s)
jobs.description_text:
Please only apply to one of our Job Postings. At the bottom of the application questions below you'll have the option to indicate if there are any other roles here at Radix that you might be interested in. Please do not submit multiple applications for different positions.  

As a Quantitative Researcher, your focus is on identifying trading opportunities, but you can add even more value with strong quantitative skills and some coding proficiency to accelerate the innovation process and help others leverage your work. 
 
By working on a variety of projects with different collaborators over the start of your career, you’ll gain new knowledge and insight into the fundamentals of market dynamics, trading strategies, and our proprietary research platform. We believe in learning through impactful work, so while you learn the intricacies of our industry, you’ll have plenty of opportunities to contribute and directly affect our bottom line within your first few weeks on the team.  
 
While interest in trading is key, a background in finance is definitely not. Our team is built mostly from academia — not from other trading firms. We seek mental diversity and add a select group of academics each year from a wide range of disciplines. 
 
COMPENSATION – Competitive salary, plus quarterly bonus based on individual performance and contribution towards success of others and the firm.

As a Quantitative Researcher, your focus is on identifying trading opportunities, but you can add even more value with strong quantitative skills and some coding proficiency to accelerate the innovation process and help others leverage your work. 
 
By working on a variety of projects with different collaborators over the start of your career, you’ll gain new knowledge and insight into the fundamentals of market dynamics, trading strategies, and our proprietary research platform. We believe in learning through impactful work, so while you learn the intricacies of our industry, you’ll have plenty of opportunities to contribute and directly affect our bottom line within your first few weeks on the team.  
 
While interest in trading is key, a background in finance is definitely not. Our team is built mostly from academia — not from other trading firms. We seek mental diversity and add a select group of academics each year from a wide range of disciplines. 
 
COMPENSATION – Competitive salary, plus quarterly bonus based on individual performance and contribution towards success of others and the firm.

jobs.title: Finance Manager, Marketplace ⭐
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a highly motivated and analytical SFA/Manager to take full ownership of our global e-commerce Marketplace P&L, one of Achievers' most important revenue streams. This role sits at the intersection of Finance, Business Intelligence, Customer Success, Merchandising, and Product, translating Marketplace activity into financial insight, strategic forecasting, and operational action. You won't just report the numbers - you'll explain what happened, forecast what comes next, and actively shape the strategy and direction to help support growth. From building predictive models and share-of-wallet analyses to partnering with Customer Success on NRR strategy and existing customer ARR forecasting, this is a role for someone who wants to make a measurable impact across the business. If you bring experience from e-commerce, retail, or a rewards/marketplace environment, that's a significant advantage, you'll hit the ground running with an intuitive understanding of redemption and e-commerce dynamics, catalogue economics, and customer purchasing behavior that are central to this role.

jobs.title: Global Indirect Tax Manager
jobs.description_text: As a Global Indirect Tax Manager, you will be joining a growing global SaaS company where tax is a strategic business partner. You will lead the day-to-day execution of Achievers’ global indirect tax program, overseeing compliance, audits, tax technology, and providing indirect tax guidance on new products, commercial initiatives, and international expansion. You will partner closely with Sales, Legal, Finance, Product, Customer Success, IT, and external advisors to provide practical tax guidance that supports business objectives. You will provide day-to-day guidance and technical direction to the Indirect Tax Analyst, helping set priorities, coordinate workload, and ensure high-quality execution of global indirect tax activities. You will work closely with the Senior Manager, Indirect Tax and Corporate Accounting, who provides strategic direction, supports complex tax matters, and performs final review of key tax positions and deliverables. This role is ideal for an indirect tax professional with strong Canadian and/or U.S. experience who is ready to broaden their international exposure, work in a fast-paced and evolving environment, and help shape the tax processes and technology supporting a growing global SaaS business. This hybrid position is based at our Toronto headquarters, with an expectation of working in the office two days per week.

jobs.description_text: We are seeking a strategic and execution-focused Senior Analyst, Deal Desk to help evolve and mature our Deal Desk function. This is a hands-on individual contributor role that combines day-to-day deal execution with subject matter expertise and functional ownership. You will operate as both a player and a builder—owning deal desk ticket execution and complex deal support while driving process optimization, automation, and scalable improvements.
